description: 千川掉量诊断器。用户描述掉量症状，按决策树一步步走，两分钟给出第一动作。 触发方式：/ljh-qianchuan、「千川消耗掉了」「投放量突然没了」「ROI 掉了怎么办」 Douyin ad (Qianchuan) traffic-drop diagnostic tool. Walks through a decision tree one node at a time to find the first action within two minutes. Trigger: /ljh-qianchuan, "my ad spend dropped", "Qianchuan traffic disappeared", "ROI suddenly dropped" 不要在非千川的广告平台问题或网站流量下降问题上自动触发。
